title: TEJAS INFRA ONE
about: Tejas Infra One provides engineering, construction and contracting solutions across residential, commercial, industrial and infrastructure sectors, from Hyderabad.
brief: The company needed a credible, professional online home that presents its range of construction and contracting work to clients and partners.
did: Designed and built a multi-page website: Home, About, Services, Projects, Industries, Careers, News, Blog and Contact
Carried a gold-and-white identity through the interface, with clear "Explore Projects" and "Contact Us" calls to action
Added a quick "Get In Touch" route, a tap-to-call link and an admin portal link
overview: Tejas Infra One is a Hyderabad-based engineering and construction contractor working across residential, commercial, industrial and infrastructure projects. The site covers About, Services, Projects, Industries, Careers, News and Blog.
design: A full-screen hero with a 'scroll to enter' reveal sets a premium tone under the line “International Expertise. Local Excellence.”, carried through with white-and-gold branding and large project photography.
tech: Built with Next.js and optimised images, with a floating WhatsApp button, “Start Your Project” enquiry calls-to-action and an admin portal for managing content.
outcome: A credible corporate home that puts the company’s track record up front — 30+ years of experience and 500+ projects delivered — with clear routes for clients, partners and job seekers.

title: OLIVE OAK
about: OliveOak is the signature interior design identity of TEV Contractors, Singapore, serving homes and businesses in Hyderabad with turnkey interiors, design consultation and space planning.
brief: The brand needed a showcase that feels as refined as its interiors and turns visitors into consultation bookings.
did: Built a cinematic, scroll-led intro and animated hero
Created Projects, Services, Blog and Contact pages with project cards and article teasers
Added "Book Consultation" and "Begin Your Design Journey" calls to action with WhatsApp, phone and email shortcuts
overview: OliveOak Interiors designs residential and commercial interiors from Singapore and Hyderabad. The site presents its services — custom furniture, room styling, space planning, renovations and lighting design — alongside featured projects and a blog.
design: A cinematic, scroll-driven intro built from an image-frame sequence (“From Singapore, For India”), followed by clean project cards and generous, calm interior photography.
tech: Lightweight static HTML pages with a scroll-scrubbed WebP frame sequence, plus one-tap WhatsApp, phone and email contact.
outcome: A fast, story-led portfolio that lets prospective clients see the studio’s work first and reach the team in a single tap.

title: HABAENE
about: HABÄNE is a travel-luggage brand built around the idea "Travel, Intelligently": a small, coherent system of luggage, carry bags and accessories, designed in Germany.
brief: The brand needed an online store that explains a connected product system, not just a list of bags.
did: Built a product grid with sorting, a comparison drawer and a cart
Added a three-question "Find Your Object" matcher plus product passport and pack-it-virtually features
Included order tracking, customer reviews, a shipping and returns FAQ, a journal and newsletter signup
Gave it a dark, bold, animated look with a Berlin clock, euro pricing and a region selector
overview: HABÄNE is a travel-technology luggage brand — “Designed in Berlin. Built for the world.” The site is its complete online store, with shop, journal, order tracking, press and full EU and India legal pages.
design: A minimal, editorial layout with uppercase numbered section labels (“01 / Signature Carry”), a hero image slider and crisp navy-and-white branding.
tech: A custom storefront with a cart drawer, filters and sorting, product comparison, a “Find Your Object” matcher, Stripe payments, an EU/EN switch and Cloudflare protection.
outcome: A complete direct-to-customer shop, from discovery to secure checkout, that showcases a 4.9/5 average rating from 1,248+ customers and a 30-day money-back guarantee.

title: NAMMASWATHU
about: NammaSwathu offers end-to-end assistance with property documentation: registration and legal paperwork for farmland, residential plots, apartments and commercial spaces.
brief: A paperwork-heavy service needed to feel simple and trustworthy online.
did: Laid out a clear four-step "How It Works" journey and a free-consultation call to action
Built Services, Information Center, Latest Updates and FAQ sections
Added OTP email login with a "My Bookings" area and cart
Placed floating WhatsApp and call buttons on every page
overview: NammaSwathu handles property registration and legal documentation for buyers, sellers, tenants, landlords and NRIs, with around 40 services that can be chosen and booked online.
design: A clear icon-card layout that turns complex legal services into simple, scannable choices, supported by an Information Center, latest updates and FAQs.
tech: WordPress with WooCommerce for service booking and cart, Elementor pop-up enquiry forms, OTP login, a My Bookings area, and WhatsApp and call buttons.
outcome: Paperwork that used to need office visits can now be compared, priced and booked online, with every booking tracked in one place.

title: ORDIENT INFRA
about: Ordient Infra is a Bengaluru construction company offering home construction and commercial construction, including offices, retail, warehouses and luxury villas.
brief: Homeowners and businesses needed to understand costs and options before picking up the phone.
did: Published transparent pricing packages and a cost calculator
Added floor plans, Projects and Luxury Projects, a Home Building Guide and a Building Materials section
Included Blogs, Careers, Reviews and banking-partner pages
Built a contact form with a project-type selector, plus call and WhatsApp buttons, an FAQ and testimonials
overview: Ordient Infra is a construction company in Hebbal, Bengaluru, building custom homes, luxury apartments, villas and renovations, as well as offices, retail, industrial units and warehouses.
design: A full-width hero — “Building Excellence Since Day One” — with two clear calls-to-action, photo-led service cards and side-by-side package pricing cards.
tech: WordPress with a custom theme, a construction cost calculator, floor plans, quote and contact forms, plus “Call Us” and WhatsApp buttons in the header.
outcome: Visitors can compare build packages (from ₹2,180 per sq.ft.), estimate costs and book in directly — turning the site into a steady lead-generation tool.

title: INFRATRADEHUB
about: InfraTradeHub is a tech-enabled B2B marketplace and house of brands for construction materials, based in Dubai and serving developers, contractors and institutions across the GCC and beyond.
brief: The business needed a trade-grade storefront that handles a wide range of materials and large buyers.
did: Built a product shop with filters for category, price, length, width and thickness
Organised materials into wood, reinforcement bar, wire mesh, commercial steel, cement, electrical and hardware
Created pages for project supply, retail distribution, warehousing and re-export
Added a blog, careers, "Get in Touch", WhatsApp, an FAQ and client quotes
overview: InfraTradeHub is a Dubai-based B2B marketplace supplying construction materials — cement, steel, rebar, tiles, electricals and hardware — to developers, contractors and institutions across the GCC.
design: A bold stats row, four-column category tiles, service cards and a video section that frame the company as a large-scale, dependable supplier.
tech: WordPress with a filterable product catalogue, WhatsApp contact, and dedicated pages for project supply, retail distribution, warehousing and re-export.
outcome: A searchable catalogue of 15+ product categories that presents the business at its real scale: 500K+ orders delivered across 15+ countries.

title: ORDIENT VENTURES
about: Ordient Ventures is an export facilitator for infrastructure businesses, SMEs and new entrepreneurs, covering export documentation, customs house agent services, logistics and warehousing, buyer-seller connect and advisory.
brief: Exporters needed one place to understand each service and get started quickly.
did: Built service pages for export documentation, CHA, logistics and warehousing, Buyer–Seller Connect and advisory
Presented case studies such as cement to Oman, prefabricated structures to Saudi Arabia and steel to Malaysia
Added vendor registration, an enquiry form, WhatsApp chat, a newsletter box and client quotes
overview: Ordient Ventures helps Indian infrastructure manufacturers and SMEs export tiles, laminates, lighting, plywood, steel, hardware and stone, handling documentation, customs, logistics, warehousing and buyer connections.
design: A video hero — “India’s Infrastructure Export Launchpad” — with service cards, a mission-vision-values block and real export case studies.
tech: WordPress with enquiry forms, WhatsApp chat, vendor registration, the Ordient.MARKET vendor section and newsletter sign-up.
outcome: A launchpad where new vendors register and enquire, backed by case studies of supply to Oman, Saudi Arabia and Malaysia.

title: BANGALORE PUPPY FARM
about: Bangalore Puppy Farm is a dog breeder in Whitefield, Bengaluru, presenting breeds such as Golden Retriever, Labrador, Poodle, Maltese, Bichon Frise and German Shepherd, along with grooming and adoption.
brief: Families needed a friendly, easy way to meet the breeds and reach the farm directly.
did: Created breed pages with per-breed Call and WhatsApp buttons
Built About, Puppy Grooming, Adoption, Gallery, Blogs and Contact sections
Added a photo gallery, testimonials, a newsletter signup and a chat pop-up
overview: Bangalore Puppy Farm is a breeder in Whitefield, Bengaluru, offering Golden Retrievers, Labradors, Toy Poodles, Maltese, German Shepherds and exotic breeds, along with adoption.
design: A warm, friendly layout with photo-led breed cards, a gallery grid and playful animated puppy graphics.
tech: A custom-built site with a page for every breed, Call and WhatsApp buttons on each breed card, a floating WhatsApp chat and a blog.
outcome: Families can browse breeds and reach the breeder in one tap, with KCI and AWBI licences and 24×7 after-sales support shown up front.

title: PESTCAT
about: PestCat provides pest control services in Bangalore for homes and businesses, including cockroach, ant, termite, bed bug, rodent, mosquito and wood borer control.
brief: Customers needed to pick the right service and plan for their home or office in a couple of taps.
did: Built Residential and Commercial sections with a plan selector by home size (1 BHK to villa, office) and plan length
Created dedicated pages for each pest service
Added Offers, About, Contact and Blog pages, customer reviews, a callback request and call and WhatsApp buttons
overview: PestCat is a Bangalore pest control company serving homes and businesses for cockroaches, termites, bedbugs, mosquitoes, rodents, wood borers, mould and dust mites.
design: A fresh green theme with full-width banners tuned separately for desktop and mobile, card-based sections and animated icons.
tech: WordPress with a custom theme, a plan selector (pest, property type and service frequency), click-to-call and WhatsApp, a reviews carousel and a blog.
outcome: Customers pick a plan and request a callback in minutes, reassured by 15+ years of experience and 40,000+ clients across Bangalore.

title: SHIVABAKTHI
about: Shivabakthi is a devotional and spiritual community website.
brief: The community needed a calm, easy-to-navigate home on the web.
did: Designed and developed the website with a clean, responsive layout
overview: Shivabakthi is a devotional and spiritual community website, giving devotees a calm, easy-to-navigate place to come together online.
design: A clean, peaceful and responsive layout that keeps the focus on devotional content.
tech: A responsive website designed and developed by My3 Digital to work smoothly on phones and desktops.
outcome: A dedicated online home for the community that is simple to browse and easy to return to.

title: SIRI TRADER
about: Siri Traders is presented on its site as "Fast & Reliable Grocery Delivery".
brief: The business needed a clear, dependable web presence.
did: Designed and developed the website with a clean, responsive layout
overview: Siri Traders is a grocery delivery store for daily home needs, serving areas around Patancheru, Ameenpur, Isnapur and Beeramguda with both retail and wholesale ordering.
design: A bright, app-like shopping layout with a scrolling offers ticker, festive combo deals, category tiles, Today’s Deals and Bestsellers rows.
tech: A React single-page app with product categories and detail pages, cart, checkout, order history, order tracking, user profiles and Cloudflare analytics.
outcome: Customers order everyday groceries online for delivery in about 30 minutes, choosing retail or wholesale in one tap.
